get.description: One authenticated SSE stream. Event data contains stable resource IDs, not complete resources. Reconnect with Last-Event-ID for bounded in-process replay. Replay does not survive a restart. stream.reset can require a REST refetch or provide a safe replay cursor. Replayed events can be duplicated. The stream starts with retry: 3000 and sends keep-alive comments every 15 seconds. Comments are ignored by SSE parsing. Database and authentication failures before streaming starts use the normal JSON error shape.
